title: (No AI) Jensen Huang reportedly tells Nvidia staff it’s ‘not true’ Trump got him rehired
author: Emma Roth
content:
![A photo of Jensen Huang](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/gettyimages-2300373989.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologized to staff during his first all-hands since returning to the company, while attempting to distance himself from the narrative that the White House and tech leaders helped him get his job back, according to [reports from _Bloomberg_](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-24/nvidia-s-huang-to-host-all-hands-meeting-a-day-after-his-return)_,_ [_The New York Times_](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/24/technology/jensen-huang-apology-nvidia-ceo.html), and [_The Handbasket's_ Marisa Kabas](https://bsky.app/profile/marisakabas.bsky.social/post/3n33bk6pymk2s).

During the meeting, Huang reportedly called claims that President Donald Trump was directly involved in his reinstatement - an idea [publicly promoted by Trump himself](https://www.theverge.com/policy/1040096/trump-nvidia-jensen-huang-reinstated) - "completely untrue." He added, "Don't think for a second politics played a role in the company. We are the most apolitical company," [according to Kabas](https://bsky.app/profile/marisakabas.bsky.social/post/3n33bk6pymk2s).

title: (No AI) David Fincher is being dragged for suspected use of AI in his latest film
author: Charles Pulliam-Moore
content:
![A man wearing a brown shirt and a puka shell necklace sitting with his legs crossed in a cluttered office.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/UFP25_R4_Rec709_2p4gamma_6188x3240_20260828.0363314_R2.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=20.001873779297,0,79.998126220703,100)

Though [David Fincher](https://www.theverge.com/streaming/1004323/netflix-david-fincher-shawn-levy-mike-flanagan-duffer-brothers-greta-gerwig)'s fans had been eagerly anticipating _The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth_, early screenings of the _Once Upon a Time in Hollywood_ sequel starring Brad Pitt have raised questions about whether generative AI was used in the film. People have claimed that the movie is chock-full of uncanny, inconsistent visuals that make it feel more like slop than the sort of polished film you'd expect from the director of sleek productions like _Fight Club_ and _The Social Network_.
